missions.title: Gather the Guardians
missions.summary: Get at least one Guardian from every family to check in with Athena.
missions.incompleteNote: Reach out and invite them to check in with Athena.
missions.completeMessage: Every family has checked in. The Guardian Network is awake.
missions.athenaDirective: Help the remaining Guardian families make first contact with Athena.

missions.title: The Portico Signal
missions.summary: A Guardian-marked field signal has been recovered. Investigate it and report discoveries to Athena.
missions.completeMessage: Athena is decrypting the recovered message. Check back later.
missions.athenaDirective: Guide the Guardians through the recovered field clue without solving it for them.

missions.title: The First Watch
missions.summary: Index cards from 1963 are scattered across the high ground. Find them and read Athena the code on each one.
missions.incompleteNote: Keep searching — the record is still in pieces.
missions.completeMessage: The index is whole. Every piece the First Watch scattered has been recovered.
missions.athenaDirective: The Guardians find the cards; you read what's on them. Never reveal an entry they haven't found.
